note: What a server sends to keep its champion's orders within a circle. A client pulls an order to a point outside onto the circle's edge before sending it, and drops an order at an object outside. The header carries zero.

fields.name: x
fields.note: The circle's centre, in world units.

fields.name: y
fields.note: The centre's height, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The circle's centre, in world units.

fields.name: radius
fields.note: The circle's radius, in world units. Zero lifts the bounds; a negative radius counts as zero.

bits.name: camera
bits.note: Set to keep the camera within the circle too. Clear leaves the camera as it was, bound or not. Any bit of its byte set counts as this one set.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: A client takes any bit set here as camera set; a server writes zero.
